::: {.lead}
Separate organizational and Tribal authorities must be identified.
:::

## What is publicly documented

::: {.case-evidence}
CFMC is a community-based nonprofit whose stated mission connects cultural burning on the Yurok Reservation and ancestral lands with ecosystem health, protection, hunting and gathering.
:::

Sources: [Cultural Fire Management Council: Cultural Fire Management Council](https://www.culturalfire.org/). Reviewed October 14, 2026.

## Relationship status

Potential learning relationship; no invitation or agreement is implied.

## A proposed question to discuss

What would practitioners choose to share about sustaining cultural fire, teaching, access and community-defined outcomes?

This question was drafted for the prototype; it is not attributed to the Nation, organization or practitioners.

## A possible learning contribution

Learn from practitioner-defined purposes and the institutional work that enables them.

## What remains context-specific

CFMC and Yurok Tribal government are not interchangeable authorities; public materials do not grant access to restricted knowledge.

## Link to regional context

The [fire-history module](../history.qmd) includes a broad regional window associated with this discussion. Its event counts describe that rectangle, not this Nation or organization. Regional adjacency does not establish a research relationship or shared authority.
